scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:go && npm run test:analytics
scripts.lint: eslint gateway/src services/identity/src services/catalog/src services/notifications/src && npm run lint:analytics
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:go
scripts.format: npm run format:human && npm run format:go && npm run format:analytics
scripts.format:human: prettier --write "frontend/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "frontend/app/globals.css" "gateway/src/**/*.ts" "services/identity/src/**/*.ts" "services/catalog/src/**/*.ts" "services/notifications/src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.mjs" "gateway/test/**/*.mjs" "services/*/test/**/*.mjs" "databases/**/*.js" "docker-compose*.yml" package.json frontend/package.json gateway/package.json services/identity/package.json services/catalog/package.json services/notifications/package.json
scripts.format:check: npm run format:human:check && npm run format:go:check && npm run format:analytics:check
scripts.format:human:check: prettier --check "frontend/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "frontend/app/globals.css" "gateway/src/**/*.ts" "services/identity/src/**/*.ts" "services/catalog/src/**/*.ts" "services/notifications/src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.mjs" "gateway/test/**/*.mjs" "services/*/test/**/*.mjs" "databases/**/*.js" "docker-compose*.yml" package.json frontend/package.json gateway/package.json services/identity/package.json services/catalog/package.json services/notifications/package.json
